description.zh: 您的播流域名。域名类型为：**liveVideo**。
description.en: The streaming domain. The type of the domain name is **liveVideo**.

description.zh: 您的推流域名。域名类型为：**liveEdge**。
description.en: The ingest domain. The type of the domain name is **liveEdge**.

title.zh: 添加播流域名和推流域名的映射关系

descriptions.zh:
先调用[AddLiveDomain接口](~~2847789~~)添加播流域名和推流域名，才能调用本接口添加直播域名中播流域名和推流域名的映射关系配置。

## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为30次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
Call the [AddLiveDomain](~~88327~~) operation to add a streaming domain and an ingest domain, and then call this operation to create the mapping between the two domain names.

## [](#qps-)QPS limit

You can call this operation up to 30 times per second per account. Requests that exceed this limit are dropped and you will experience service interruptions. We recommend that you take note of this limit when you call this operation. For more information, see [QPS limits](~~343507~~).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live add-live-domain-mapping --push-domain demo.aliyundoc.com --pull-domain example.com --region cn-hangzhou
